help.startStopNext: begin, end, or advance the recording.

start.lead: Cavox runs a recording session in the browser: it presents the prompts of the loaded script, captures audio from the selected device, and keeps every recording with its metadata.

session.title: Session
session.lead: Enter the session id to load its script and recordings.
session.pickConfiguration: Choose a stored configuration to try out
session.noConfigurations: No stored configurations found. Enter a session id to continue.

tooltip.respondent: Show the prompt stage on the second screen ({{key}})
tooltip.playPrompt: Play the sound of the current prompt again ({{key}})

error.contextClosed: Error on start capture: The audio context is already closed.
error.noScriptProcessor: Browser does not support audio processing (ScriptProcessor.onaudioprocess method not found)!
error.noAudioProcessing: Browser does not support audio processing (neither AudioWorkletProcessor nor ScriptProcessor)!
error.microphoneNotAllowed: Not allowed to use your microphone.
error.deviceRead: Could not read from your audio device.
error.handleRecordedData: Could not handle recorded audio data{{detail}}

advice.allowMicrophone: Please make sure that microphone access is allowed for this web page and reload the page.
advice.checkDevice: Please make sure your audio device is working.

capture.permissionNeeded: Microphone access is needed to list the devices
capture.missing: The selected device is not available
capture.recordingBlocked: Stop the recording to change the device

error.contextClosed: Error: Cannot start playback. Audio context is already closed!
error.selectionContextClosed: Error: Cannot start playback of selection. Audio context is already closed!

recordings.title: Recording list
recordings.editHint: On export or delivery the editing selection of the recording file is cut out. If no editing selection is applied the original file is exported.
recordings.applyCurrentSelection: Apply current selection as editing selection

session.finishedBody: Thank you! The recording session is complete.
session.exportError: The recordings could not be exported.
session.exportNone: There are no recordings to export.

dialog.unknownError: An unknown error occurred during recording.

dialog.sessionSealedAdvice: Please ask your experimenter what to do (e.g start a new session).

dialog.noAudioDeviceAdvice: Please connect an audio device and retry (press the browser reload button) or try to continue anyway.

dialog.networkAdvice: Please check network connection and server state.
dialog.networkAdviceAdmin: Please check network connection and server state or contact application administrator.
dialog.unsupportedBrowserMsg: Browser does not support Media/Audio API!
dialog.uploadFailedMsg: Upload failed. Recordings were not stored on the server.

status.uploadError: Upload error occurred. Please check your network connection.

status.datasetPending: Please wait until audio processing and upload have finished. Please do not leave the page.

respondent.waitingBody: This window shows the prompt stage of the running session. It connects as soon as the recorder window sends it.
respondent.unsupportedBody: This browser cannot mirror the stage into a second window. Chrome 107+, Edge 107+, Firefox 104+ and Safari 16+ can.
respondent.blocked: The browser blocked the respondent window. Allow popups for this site and try again.
respondent.unsupportedStatus: This browser cannot show the respondent display (needs Chrome 107+, Edge 107+, Firefox 104+ or Safari 16+).
